Lina (CS): Heads-up: several mid-tier trial tenants are reporting slow activations and missing search results after last night's indexing rollout. A few are in evaluation with renewal conversations coming up. I'm proposing proactive outreach and a short-term compensation offer.

Evan (Eng): Thanks. Root cause preliminary: reindex job collisions with retention sweeper causing shard contention. I've queued a low-risk config change to throttle the sweeper for affected clusters. Patch PR: https://git.redwood/internal/reindex-fix/PR-5421. Planning a staged rollout in 15m.

Lina (CS): Good. Can we commit to a visible improvement window (X hours) so I can message customers? We need something we can confidently guarantee to trials.

Evan (Eng): Expect measurable improvement within 2 hours after throttling; full catch-up may be 6-12 hours depending on dataset size. Will post metrics (search.latency_p95, index.backlog_count).

Priya (Support): I'll create a support triage list and a short diagnostic doc customers can run pre-office-hours (checks: last ingest time, shard-stats command, and upload retry steps). Scheduling two office hours slots tomorrow.

Diego (Sales): Please tag accounts with renewal dates within 60 days and ARR > $50k. I'll hold off renewal outreach and prepare a short exec note if we need to escalate.

Marta (Product): For credits, recommend flat $500 account credit for affected trials or 5k token credit, whichever is more relevant to their usage profile. Keep exceptions for enterprise pending Ops sign-off.

DeployBot: rollout/PR-5421 started by evan.eng  canary 10% -> ok -> expand to 50%. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/5421

Evan (Eng): Canary passed, expanding. search.latency_p95 dropped from 3200ms to 450ms on canary nodes. index.backlog_count reduced by ~80%. Monitoring in progress.

Lina (CS): Draft customer note (short + transparent). Please edit: 

"Hi <Customer>,

We're contacting you about a recent issue impacting indexing and activation for some trial accounts. Our engineers identified a conflict in background jobs introduced during the nightly index rollout and have deployed a mitigation. You may see improved search freshness and faster activations over the next few hours.

What we're doing for you:
- Prioritized troubleshooting and two dedicated office hours for your team (link in invite)
- A one-time account credit while we validate full recovery
- Hourly status updates until we hit stable metrics

We value your evaluation and will follow up with a short technical summary and next steps.

Regards,
Lina, Customer Success"

Priya (Support): I'll attach the diagnostics checklist and the office-hours RSVP, and include a short feedback form for impact capture.

Diego (Sales): Sending me the affected-account list and Ill prepare personalized outreach if any account requests exec touch.

Evan (Eng): Rollout complete. All canaries and expanded nodes show stable metrics. search.latency_p95 steady <500ms, backlog drained. Putting the cluster on a 24h watch.

DeployBot: monitoring.alert cleared for index.backlog_count on cluster-east-2 at 1777778988

Marta (Product): I'll kick off a follow-up postmortem draft with the mitigation plan: make the sweeper job respect active reindex locks and add a checkpoint to reindex so long-running ingests don't get preempted.

Lina (CS): Thanks team. Action items:
- Evan: add a quick rollback + post-deploy validation checklist to the PR and share final metrics (ETA 1h)
- Priya: confirm office-hours invites sent and diagnostics doc linked in outreach
- Diego: pause renewal nudges for tagged accounts and prep exec note templates
- Marta: start postmortem doc and credit approval flow with Ops

Priya (Support): Office hours invites sent, diagnostics doc attached, and a one-question feedback form included. I'll export attendance and responses after sessions.

Diego (Sales): Received account list, will queue outreach for any exec escalations.

Evan (Eng): Metrics posted: search.latency_p95 and index.backlog_count dashboards updated. Marking incident mitigated; continuing monitoring.

Lina (CS): I'll send the customer note now and follow up with a postmortem summary once Marta completes it. We'll include the credit offer and an optional walkthrough. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :heart:
